blocks.text: Actress-politician Cai Cortez has issued an apology for the dancing-while-driving incident and vowed to cooperate with the Land Transportation Office (LTO) regarding the matter. The Taytay councilor was earlier issued a show cause order (SCO) after a video showed her taking both her hands off the steering wheel to dance while her vehicle was moving. The LTO also ordered the councilor to surrender her driver’s license for a 90-day suspension.
